caseName: Smith v. Louisiana & Arkansas Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Smith v. Louisiana & Arkansas Railway Co.
attorneys: Messrs. Wils Davis and W. S. Atkins for petitioner. Mr. A. L. Burford for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Black is of opinion that certiorari should be granted.
